t: Kon-Tiki expedition - Wikipedia
s: December 30, 2025 - The Kon-Tiki expedition was a 1947 journey by raft across the Pacific Ocean from South America to the Polynesian islands, led by Norwegian explorer and ethnographer Thor Heyerdahl.
